bug_summary: Python3.10以降でPEP563文字列化アノテーションをeval_str=Trueで評価していなかったため、__call__を持つインスタンス依存等で型解決に失敗する
pr_diff:
diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
index 1ff35f648..91348c8ea 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py
@@ -1,6 +1,5 @@
 import dataclasses
 import inspect
-import sys
 from contextlib import AsyncExitStack, contextmanager
 from copy import copy, deepcopy
 from dataclasses import dataclass
@@ -192,10 +191,7 @@ def get_flat_params(dependant: Dependant) -> List[ModelField]:
 
 
 def get_typed_signature(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> inspect.Signature:
-    if sys.version_info >= (3, 10):
-        signature = inspect.signature(call, eval_str=True)
-    else:
-        signature = inspect.signature(call)
+    signature = inspect.signature(call)
     unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
     globalns = getattr(unwrapped, "__globals__", {})
     typed_params = [
@@ -221,10 +217,7 @@ def get_typed_annotation(annotation: Any, globalns: Dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
 
 
 def get_typed_return_annotation(call: Callable[..., Any]) -> Any:
-    if sys.version_info >= (3, 10):
-        signature = inspect.signature(call, eval_str=True)
-    else:
-        signature = inspect.signature(call)
+    signature = inspect.signature(call)
     unwrapped = inspect.unwrap(call)
     annotation = signature.return_annotation
pr_description: Drops the sys.version_info branch and the now-unused sys import from both helpers, calling inspect.signature(call) directly instead. Reduces duplicated conditional logic across the two functions.
